issue.title: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'current') when adding --turbo in Next.js
issue.body: I have already raised this issue at Vercel's repo. Full description and a source code can be found [here](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/57936), but thought I'll post it here as well. Not sure whether it's on Vercel's or your part, but I hope it gets fixed soon. Thanks a lot!

issue.title: fix(turbopack): `react-dom/server` in rsc context
issue.body:
### What?
Probably not the right solution, next.js disables the `react-server` import condition in there somehow I think

### Why?

Resend uses `@react-email/render` which uses `renderToString` from `react-dom/server`.
Unfortunately importing `react-dom/server` with the `react-server` import condition leads to a broken bundle (which seems like a bug in react?).

Closes PACK-2243
Fixes #57936
